text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... I actually received a letter 
from one of the girls running in my next 
mock race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Inside was an encouraging note saying, 
'Let us both give it our absolute 
best'—gh...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Don't let them sway you, self...! To build 
a passionate bond with a rival in the 
Central...? Khh...!
